project.ppeList:
- Hard hat
- Safety glasses
- High-visibility vest when exposed to equipment or public traffic
- Work boots with defined heel
- Cut-resistant gloves as task requires
- Hearing protection when noise requires raised voice
- Fall protection when required by task
project.gcRules: Follow GC site-specific rules when they are stricter than DOCON rules.
project.notes: Replace blank names and phones before first day of work. Do not mobilize with empty superintendent or 911-caller fields.

emergency.directions911: Give civic center name, street address, floor/area, nearest cross street, and gate. If cell service fails, designated employee goes to nearest visible public road.

climate.notes: High elevation: dehydration and UV remain risks even on mild days. Winter: ice, snow, vehicle access, hypothermia. Indoor finish work may still hit 82F in unconditioned spaces.

calOsha.342Text: Report a serious injury, illness, or death to the nearest Cal/OSHA district office as soon as possible but no later than 8 hours (8 CCR 342).
